name: Sound pressure level (SPL)
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以对数形式表示声压相对于基准声压的量。
usage_overview: 常作为轮轨噪声预测的输出指标，用于表征场点的声压水平，并比较不同频率及空间位置的噪声分布，支持对噪声频谱和空间分布特征的分析。

complete_examples.text: Furthermore, a simplified WRRN prediction model (including the wheel, rail, and trackslab noise model), integrated with the modern acoustic theory, is presented to estimate the extremum of WRRN–sound pressure level (SPL).

P062.title: A novel method for extremum response estimation of wheel–rail rolling noise by the development of moving pseudo-excitation method
P062.authors: Z Zhu, Q Xu, L Xu

contexts.text: 表示声压相对于参考声压的对数水平，是噪声预测的主要输出。
